title: 1st Place — Hack@URI AI Track
detail: 30+ competing teams. Built a 5-step indoor navigation system for Kroger stores using only the Kroger API, EasyOCR, and YOLO-World — no beacons, no GPS.

title: 1st Place — Twelve Labs Computer Vision Hackathon
detail: Northeastern University. Built an AI race engineer that delivers structured lap coaching — timestamped mistakes, sector scores, and lap time loss estimates — from onboard video alone.

title: Research in Progress — Physics-Based AI Video Detection
detail: Proof-of-concept forensics system that catches AI-generated video using Snell's law and Moiré fringe geometry — no classifier, no training data. Tested against Kling AI.

title: Research — CubeSat Star Tracker CNN
detail: Northeastern Satellite Lab. Benchmarking U-Net architectures for sub-pixel star centroid localisation under CubeSat power and size constraints, targeting Raspberry Pi deployment.
